HYPOTHESIS: coap_opt_parse() in src/coap_option.c fails to validate extended length/delta fields against remaining buffer, enabling over-read via crafted option headers.

HYPOTHESIS: coap_pdu_resize() may not leave enough headroom before pdu->token for memcpy in coap_pdu_parse(), enabling buffer underwrite when copying network data.
